profile.name: Het Patel
profile.title: Full Stack MERN Developer & Web Engineer
profile.subtitle: Crafting High-Performance Web Applications & Seamless Digital Experiences
profile.bio: Full Stack Developer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), TypeScript, and high-performance modern web platforms. Experienced in architecting complex platforms like Online Examination Engine for Silver Oak University, industrial platforms for Ambika Electric, and responsive marketplace solutions.

projects.title: AMBIKA ELECTRIC
projects.subtitle: Industrial Electrical Engineering & Motor Solutions
projects.description: Production industrial web platform engineered and deployed for Ambika Electric in Kadadra, Gujarat. Features heavy industrial motor rewinding diagnostics (up to 500+ HP), custom electrical control panel fabrication (MCC, PCC, APFC), automated plant diagnostics, dynamic service inquiries, and ultra-fast responsive design.

projects.title: ONLINE EXAMINATION SYSTEM
projects.subtitle: Full Stack MERN Assessment Engine with Live Online Code Editor
projects.category: Enterprise Academic Platform • Silver Oak University
projects.description: Comprehensive academic assessment platform engineered and deployed for Silver Oak University. Features 3-tier JWT authentication (Super Admin, Faculty/Admin, Student), timed MCQ examination rooms, online code editor with live multi-language execution, automated AI evaluation engine, anti-cheat detection, and bulk student CSV enrollment.

projects.title: AGRICOLD CONNECT (STORE YOUR HARVEST)
projects.subtitle: Smart Cold Storage & Harvest Preservation Marketplace
projects.description: Smart agricultural cold storage booking and crop preservation marketplace engineered during the Silver Oak University Hackathon. Bridges smallholder farmers directly with certified refrigerated warehouses, featuring dynamic capacity booking, real-time temperature telemetry monitoring, transparent pricing, and instant SMS/WhatsApp alerts.

projects.title: SECURELIFE POLICY SYSTEM
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Insurance Lifecycle & Policy Management Engine
projects.description: Enterprise insurance policy management platform with dedicated Admin and Customer workflows. Supports multi-policy lifecycle (Health, Auto, Life, Home, Travel), expiration tracker, policy renewal proposals, and bulk CSV data imports with error logging.
